responsibility: This header defines GCC’s abstract query interfaces for singleton values and value ranges. value_query provides expression/edge/statement valueization hooks, while range_query extends it with vrange-producing queries, relation-oracle access, update hooks, and compatibility APIs such as get_value_range. It also declares the global_range_query implementation and helper accessors that return the active function range provider. This is the main interface used by passes that want range- or value-based reasoning without depending on a specific analysis engine.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract value_query and range_query APIs, plus global_range_query declarations and accessors, whereas the companion .cc file supplies their default method implementations and global query object.
